spec.name: Halloween Ghost Camera
spec.description: Holdable antique dark-oak camera with a stepped brass lens, recessed violet spectral glass, orange shutter button and an open carry handle. Axis-aligned vanilla-scale geometry, with no text or animation. Front faces negative Z.

prompt: Handheld antique dark wood camera with brass lens, little violet spectral glass window and orange shutter button. Minecraft item, holdable readable shape. Original Orange SMP Halloween asset. Vanilla Minecraft pixel scale, material-specific irregular detail, developed UV-mapped surfaces and purposeful connected cuboids. No text, no unrelated scene, no stands, no animations, no bones except the required armor rig. Preserve transparent negative space. Model geometry must be axis-aligned, with no rotated elements. Use local vanilla references for glass, pumpkin rind, wood, iron and inventory sprites. Generated artwork will be used directly in a Paper resource pack.
